title: Children's Room
what: A whole story in one request: VoiceStudio splits it into chapters, gives every line its character's voice, masters the loudness for audiobooks (ACX) and returns a chaptered m4b file.

inputs.label: Story
inputs.value: The Lamp Who Couldn't Sleep (two chapters, 17 lines)

inputs.label: Voices
inputs.value: Nell (narrator), Pip, Professor Hoot, Tilly: four fixed house voices

inputs.label: Markup
inputs.value: # Chapter headings, and [voice:NAME] before each line

inputs.label: Output
inputs.value: m4b with chapters, ACX loudness, 350 ms between lines

snippet:
import requests, json
book = """# Chapter One: The Humming Lamp
[voice:Nell] In the Voice House, everyone was asleep...
[voice:Pip] Nell? Nell, are you awake?"""
r = requests.post("http://127.0.0.1:3900/audiobook", json={
    "text": book, "voice_map": {"Nell": NELL_ID, "Pip": PIP_ID},
    "format": "m4b", "loudness": "acx"}, stream=True)
for line in r.iter_lines():  # progress events, then "done"
    print(line)
checks: Whisper heard 98% of the story's words
